essence: The practitioner wipes away the three drawn lines with the left foot.
The practitioner wipes away three black lines originating from three births.
Meditation on the lotus feet is performed to accomplish completeness in worship.
The practitioner bows to the auspicious Kumāra who holds the spear.
Obeisance is offered to the radiant one who brings about all auspiciousness.
